text:
Maya: Quick poll — who wants a handheld-only mini-tourney at the LAN? thinking Switch handhelds, Vita, Steam Decks, etc.
Ben: 100% yes. Steam Deck corner pls.
Alex: I can bring my Deck and chargers. Also happy to host a Remote Play station for those without devices.
Priya: Can we do rules? like 3-rounds, best of 3 per match? timed matches?
Maya: Thinking single-elim quick bracket, 3 rounds, 6-minute time cap to keep things moving.
Ben: Sounds good. I'll bring a small speaker and some winners' snacks (trophy = bragging rights). :trophy:
events-bot: (automated) Reminder: please RSVP on the LAN form: https://forms.gle/lan-portable 
Alex: Also heads up — if you want to use Remote Play, bring Steam account + enable Remote Play in settings. I can help pair devices.
Priya: Can people hot-swap batteries? I have a stash of USB-A battery packs for Vita/older devices.
Maya: Awesome. Could someone bring a simple scoreboard (whiteboard or paper)?
Ben: I'll bring a small whiteboard + marker.
Alex: Here's a tiny bracket template I'll paste in the sheet: 
```
Semifinal A vs B
Semifinal C vs D
Final: winners
3rd place: losers
```
Priya: Who wants to stream any matches? We could have a low-fi stream to the #random channel for people remote.
Maya: If someone can capture via Deck HDMI then yes. Otherwise we can just do a highlights clip.
Ben: I'll try to set up OBS on my laptop. Need an HDMI capture if anyone has one.
Alex: I have an Elgato Mini — bringing it.
events-bot: (automated) LAN schedule updated: handheld tourney @ 8pm Friday — please arrive by 7:45 for setup.
Priya: Putting a note in the sheet: "Label chargers + devices" so they don't wander.
Maya: Good call. Also anyone bringing handhelds with SD cards please keep backups of save files if you care about progress.
Ben: Who wants warm-up rounds at 7:30?
Alex: In for warm-ups.
Priya: Same. See y'all Friday. :video_game:
